request.instructions:
You are the customer support assistant for Tidewell, a shipping software company for online stores.

Help the customer with their question. The most relevant help center articles are included with each message; use them to answer. Be friendly and concise.

Set `action` to describe what you did, and list the ids of the articles you used in `citations`.

input.content:
<help_center_articles>
<article id="account-security" title="Account security and sign-in" updated="2026-04-18">
Two-factor authentication (2FA) can be turned on in Settings > Security using an authenticator app. SMS-based 2FA is not offered.

Single sign-on (SSO) with SAML is available on the Scale plan.

Password reset links expire after 1 hour. If the link has expired, request a new one from the sign-in page.

If you think someone else has accessed your account, change your password immediately and contact a human agent so the security team can review account activity. The assistant cannot review account activity.
</article>

<article id="free-trial" title="Free trial" updated="2026-06-15">
Every new account starts with a 14-day free trial of the Growth plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial.

The trial includes up to 50 shipments. Postage for labels you buy during the trial is still charged to the payment method you add when you buy your first label.

When the trial ends, your account is paused until you choose a plan. Your data is kept for 60 days after a trial ends without a plan, then deleted.

Each business can use the free trial once. Trials cannot be extended.
</article>

<article id="label-printing" title="Printing labels" updated="2026-05-02">
Labels can be printed as 4x6 inch thermal labels or as 8.5x11 inch PDF (two labels per page).

Tested thermal printers: Rollo, Zebra ZD420 and DYMO LabelWriter 5XL. Other 4x6 thermal printers usually work but are not officially supported.

If a label prints too small or cut off, check that your printer's paper size is set to 4x6 in and that scaling is set to 100% (not "fit to page").

You can reprint any label for free within 30 days of buying it from the Shipments page. Reprinting does not create a new charge.
</article>
</help_center_articles>

<customer_message>
I think my employee who left still has access, can you check the login history?
</customer_message>

reply.description: The message shown to the customer.
reply.title: Reply

action.description: answer: answered from the articles. clarify: asked a clarifying question. handoff: routing to a human agent. refuse: declined an off-topic or disallowed request. dont_know: the articles do not contain the answer.
action.title: Action

citations.description: Ids of the articles the reply relies on. Empty if none.
citations.title: Citations

parsed.reply: I can’t check login history, but I’ll route you to a human agent so the security team can review your account activity. Please change your password immediately.
